title: Elux Firerose 5000 Buttermints 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elux Firerose 5000 Buttermints Nic Salt captures the comforting taste of buttermint confectionery with a little minty freshness. This flavour balances delicate Peppermint notes with a subtle sugary creaminess that adds richness and depth, echoing the nostalgic charm of classic buttermints. The result is a cool, gently sweet profile with a rounded finish that's perfect for those who prefer mint flavours with a softer, mellow character. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Buttermints Nic Salt provides rich flavour, a tactile yet comfortable throat hit and discreet vapour production. Ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this e-liquid works brilliantly in pod kits, vape pens and other low-powered devices. Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salts bring popular flavours from the Elux range to refillable vape kits, delivering convenience, value, and a satisfying experience from every 10ml bottle.
